register_all_scannet_context20_100K: register all ScanNet20 context instance datasets with 100K splits using the given root directory
register_all_dataset: register all predefined dataset splits for a specified dataset name like ai2thor or scannet200
register_all_scannet_context20_scannet_s: register all ScanNet20 single-instance context datasets with 100K splits from the given root
register_all_dataset_single: register all single-instance dataset splits for a specified dataset like ai2thor, s3dis, or matterport
register_ref: register SR3D referential grounding 3D datasets from the specified root path
